findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.citation_text:
3-101.11 Safe, Unadulterated, and Honestly Presented. FOOD shall be safe, unADULTERATED, and, as specified under § 3-601.12, honestly presented.

A single set of frozen pizzas are observed in the display freezer with expiration dates of 2/26/25. The PIC discarded the items to correct. The PIC did state that they have been having issues with their supplier lately sending items that are past their expiration dates. Per the PIC these items are normally caught prior to being placed on the shelves but they have been off the past couple of days.

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.comment:
6-202.15: (A) Outer openings of FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against entry of insects and rodents. (B) Does not apply to FOOD ESTABLISHMENTS which opens into larger structure. (C) Exterior doors need not be self-closing if designed for limited-use. (D) If opening present, opening shall be protected against rodent and insects. (E) Paragraph (D) not applicable when pests are absent. 

Observed back room exterior door to not be solid and tight fitting. New seal to prohibit access to pests.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Drying mops: mops must be hung in a fashion that allows drip dry. C
Corrective action: hang mops upright in mop sink. COS.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3.307.11 Misc. Source of Contamination: cans are sufficiently dented with creases and can contribute to contamination. C
Corrective action: Do not take receipt of cans that are dented. COS.
